title: World tables
description: data/world.json, and the workspace's world: the tables the world map is generated from. The shape is documented and read in src/config/worldTablesShape.js normaliseWorldTables, which drops or defaults anything malformed and refuses only tables without six distinct lines (loaded by src/config/registries/worldTablesRegistry.js; without the file the game runs on src/config/worldPlaceholder.js). Drawn and edited from the CMS's Ledger World page (cms/src/engine/worldTables.js). Ring-keyed maps use the ring number as the key. Keys not listed here are reported as warnings.

lines.description: Exactly six, one wedge per hex side (LINE_COUNT), shuffled each run.

kits.description: The line's lean between kit archetypes: kit id to weight.

origins.description: Per ring, the wild nodes' Token types as weighted ids.

neighbours.description: Natural neighbours the line shuffle prefers.

neighbourStrength.description: Each point of neighbour weight makes an order this many times likelier.

mainPerCell.description: At least this many of its line's origins per cell.

blendsPerNeighbour.description: Origins a cell takes from each other wedge it touches.

keys.description: Per ring, Token types within reach of every cell one ring in.

biome.description: The ground its mat stands on (an Atlas biome).

work.description: Natural work on its mat in heroes kept busy, by skill id; combat means camps.

camps.description: The creatures' camps its combat work is.
Per ring, the camps that stand in every world: a Token id, or { id, kits }.

heroTokens.description: Tokens one hero keeps busy, per skill (else HERO_TOKENS_DEFAULT, 5).

specialtyHeroes.description: A specialty's skill gets at least this much work, in heroes.

arrival.description: Per ring, the enemies a settled place arrives with.

specialties.description: The specialty bag of every strict ring (skill ids).

pityWindow.description: A specialty absent from this many cells in a row comes next.

ringValue.description: Per ring, what a cell's extras are worth.

prices.description: Per ring, what settling a place costs.

from.description: PRICE_FROM: the source cell one ring in (default) or the Hall's cell.

skill.description: A skill id, line (the cell's line's skill) or specialty.

wild.description: The rings beyond the strict ones.

compositionShare.description: How much of a one-resource wild mat its one resource takes.
